newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BankWest down after profit warning.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BankWest down after profit warning.

text.p: Shares in Bank of Western Australia Ltd (BankWest) fell over four percent at the opening on Friday after the Perth-based bank warned its profit for the year to February 28 was likely to be five percent below its prospectus forecasts.
At 10.10 a.m. (2310 GMT), BankWest shares were 12 cents or 4.44 percent lower at A$2.58.
BankWest said on Thursday that its net profit for the year ending February 28, 1997, was likely to be five percent below the prospectus forecast of A$100.2 million.
The bank, which is 51 percent owned by Bank of Scotland Plc, said it still expected the total dividend for the year to be in line with the prospectus forecast.
